subject.title: docs(cli): generate and guard command reference

question: Should OpenClaw publish a separate operator/developer `openclaw commands` catalog and the three advisory plugin descriptor fields while retaining the existing Gateway command inventory?
rationale: Tests cannot decide permanent namespace, stable-field commitments, semantic-drift ownership, or external plugin compatibility while the linked RFC remains open.

options.title: Approve separate audiences
options.body: Accept CLI and Gateway inventories as distinct contracts, document their ownership, and land the repaired stack in dependency order.

options.title: Unify the model first
options.body: Pause implementation and consolidate overlapping command semantics behind one canonical contract before publishing another inventory.

options.title: Decline this direction
options.body: Narrow or close the stack if another public command catalog and plugin metadata contract are not planned.

recommendation.title: Approve separate audiences
recommendation.body: Accept CLI and Gateway inventories as distinct contracts, document their ownership, and land the repaired stack in dependency order.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository-wide CODEOWNERS, recent central-path history, and adjacent review routing make this the strongest available owner for the cross-surface decision.
